app.title: Redirect
app.tagline: Fixed links that point wherever you need them to.
app.open_warning: No admin password is set: anyone who can reach this page can change or delete every redirect. Set ADMIN_PASSWORD in the container's environment to require a login.
login.title: Log in
login.text: Enter the admin password to manage the redirects.
login.password.label: Password
key.title: API key
key.help: Scripts send it as Authorization: Bearer <key> to /api/redirects, to create, change or delete redirects.
key.confirm.title: Regenerate the API key?
key.confirm.text: The current key stops working at once, for every script that uses it.
key.new.title: Your new API key
key.new.text: Copy it now: it is not stored and will not be shown again.
key.new.label: API key
form.create.title: New redirect
form.edit.title: Edit redirect
form.slug.label: Path
form.slug.hint: Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores. Use / to group, as in compta/budget-2026.
form.slug.warning: Changing the path breaks the link you already shared. The old link will return “not found”.
form.name.label: Name
form.name.hint: Only shown here, to find the redirect again.
form.target.label: Target URL
form.target.hint: Where the link sends people. You can change it at any time.
list.title: Redirects
list.empty.title: No redirects yet
list.empty.text: Fill in the form to create the first one.
list.filter.label: Filter
list.filter.placeholder: Filter by name, path or target
list.target.label: Target
delete.title: Delete this redirect?
delete.text: The link {url} will stop working for everyone who has it.
status.copy_failed: Could not copy the link. Select it in the list and copy it by hand.
status.load_failed: Could not load the redirects. Reload the page to try again.
status.network: Could not reach the server. Try again.
status.server_error: The server could not complete the request. Try again.
errors.body_invalid: The request body is not valid JSON.
errors.body_too_large: The request body is too large.
errors.database_unavailable: The database cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.login_required: Log in to manage the redirects.
errors.session_required: Log in to the interface to change the settings or the API key.
errors.api_key_invalid: This API key is not valid.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.key_needs_password: Set ADMIN_PASSWORD to use an API key: without a login, the API is open anyway.
errors.api_disabled: The API is turned off. Turn it on in the interface, or with API_ENABLED.
errors.api_disabled_key: Turn the API on before generating a key.
errors.api_forced: API_ENABLED in the container's environment decides whether the API is on.
errors.hostname_invalid: Use a hostname such as redirect.lan: letters, digits and dashes, with dots between the parts.
errors.slug_too_long: The path must be at most 255 characters.
errors.slug_empty_segment: The path cannot start or end with /, or contain //.
errors.slug_dot_segment: A path segment cannot be . or ..
errors.slug_invalid: Use only letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores, with / between segments.
errors.slug_taken: This path is already used by another redirect.
errors.name_too_long: The name must be at most 100 characters.
errors.name_invalid: The name cannot contain control characters.
errors.target_too_long: The target URL must be at most 2048 characters.
errors.target_invalid: Enter a full URL that starts with http:// or https://.
notfound.title: Link not found
notfound.text: No redirect exists for {path}. The link may have been changed or removed.
notfound.text_unknown: No redirect exists at this address. The link may have been changed or removed.
unavailable.title: Redirect is unavailable
unavailable.text: The database cannot be reached right now. Try the link again in a moment.
